scope: Two API-alias availability events from one dated announcement; neither weight releases nor claims of independent underlying models.

title.zh: LTX-2.5 Fast API 可用公告

summary.zh: 官方2026-08-11 API日志登记 ltx-2-5-fast，支持文本、图像或音频驱动的视频以及横竖构图。Fast文生/图生视频最高4K，音频输入的视频为1080p。
summary.en: The official August 11, 2026 API log announces ltx-2-5-fast for text-, image- or audio-driven video in landscape and portrait. Fast text/image-to-video supports up to 4K, while audio-to-video is 1080p.

note.zh: 这是同一篇公告内一个调用别名的服务事件，不是独立权重首发、固定检查点或GA/实验状态认定。首次完整公开权重日、历史后端修订与许可证适用性未由本事件确认。公告时刻/时区未知；当前端点、分辨率、地区资格与费用未实测，须另核。资料核验日为2026-11-01，没有调用API或生成媒体。
note.en: One service event for an alias in the same announcement, not a separate weights launch, pinned checkpoint or GA/experimental classification. First complete public weights date, historical backend revision and license applicability are not established. Announcement time/timezone are unknown. Current endpoint, resolution, regional eligibility and costs were not tested and need separate verification. Sources checked November 1, 2026; no API call or media generation.
